$comment: OpenCatalogi's part of the Zuiddrecht example set, installed with `occ openregister:example-set:install zuiddrecht` (the loader lives in OpenRegister). A catalog for the municipality, themes that follow the subjects of the Zuiddrecht site, thirteen publications the dossier and saved search of the example resident Sanne de Vries (cast key sanne), and a service catalogue: three case types, five products and services (two of them need repair: one has no form name, one names a case type that does not exist) and two knowledge articles. Every date is relative to the install day. The documents of each publication are in example-sets/zuiddrecht/<publication key>/, made by scripts/example-sets/make-zuiddrecht-documents.py, and the loader attaches them as shared files. Dossiq's fragment runs after this one and finds the Woo decision by its title.

data.title: Parkeren in de blauwe zone
data.body:
In de blauwe zone mag u twee uur parkeren met een parkeerschijf. Zet de schijf op het eerstvolgende halve uur na aankomst.

Met een bewonersvergunning mag u langer parkeren, maar alleen in de zone op uw vergunning. Bezoekers gebruiken de bezoekersvergunning in de app Parkeren.
